description: A white plastic frame-like piece sits on the blue bedspread in front of a pink pillow, with a few small white block parts scattered nearby. The left hand stays near the main frame to steady it while the right hand reaches in from the right, grasps a small white block on top of the frame, lifts it upward, and then moves it rightward to set it down with the other loose pieces, leaving the main frame as a left-hand object and the block as a right-hand object during the move.
